mapper.select:
SELECT id, title, startDt, endDt, itemType, color, wsId, projId, isRecurring, recurType, recurInterval, untilDt, recurGroupId, isLunar, lunarMonth, lunarDay FROM ( SELECT EVENT_ID as id, TITLE as title, TO_CHAR(START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as startDt, /* DB에는 +1일 되어 저장되므로, 조회 시에는 원래 날짜로 복구하여 표시 */ TO_CHAR(END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as endDt, ITEM_TYPE as itemType, EVENT_COLOR as color, USER_ID, WS_ID as wsId, PROJ_ID as projId, TRUNC(START_DT) as RAW_START, /* FullCalendar 렌더링을 위해 +1일 된 상태 그대로 사용 (31일 -> 6/1) */ TRUNC(END_DT) as RAW_END, IS_RECURRING as isRecurring, RECUR_TYPE as recurType, RECUR_INTERVAL as recurInterval, TO_CHAR(RECUR_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as untilDt, RECUR_GROUP_ID as recurGroupId, IS_LUNAR as isLunar, LUNAR_MONTH as lunarMonth, LUNAR_DAY as lunarDay FROM EVENTS UNION ALL SELECT HLD_ID as id, HLD_NAME as title, TO_CHAR(HLD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD" 00:00:00"') as startDt, TO_CHAR(HLD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD" 23:59:59"') as endDt, 'HOLIDAY' as itemType, NULL as color, NULL as USER_ID, NULL as wsId, NULL as projId, HLD_DATE as RAW_START, HLD_DATE as RAW_END, 'N', NULL, 1, NULL, NULL, 'N', NULL, NULL FROM NATIONAL_HOLIDAYS ) WHERE (
(itemType = 'PRIVATE' AND USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
(itemType = 'WS' AND wsId IN ( SELECT WS_ID FROM WS_MEMBERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ))
( (itemType = 'PROJ' AND projId IN ( SELECT PROJ_ID FROM PROJ_MEMBERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} )) OR (itemType = 'TASK' AND projId IN ( SELECT PROJ_ID FROM PROJ_MEMBERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} )) )
(itemType = 'TASK' AND projId IN ( SELECT PROJ_ID FROM PROJ_MEMBERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ))
(itemType = 'HOLIDAY') 1=0
1=0
) AND ( (isLunar = 'N' AND isRecurring = 'N' AND RAW_START <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND RAW_END >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR (isLunar = 'N' AND isRecurring = 'Y' AND (untilDt IS NULL OR TO_DATE(untilDt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) OR (isLunar = 'Y' AND (untilDt IS NULL OR TO_DATE(untilDt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) )
SELECT PROJ_ROLE FROM PROJ_MEMBERS WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
SELECT WS_ROLE FROM WS_MEMBERS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NATIONAL_HOLIDAYS (HLD_ID, HLD_DATE, HLD_NAME, IS_REST, COUNTRY) VALUES (SEQ_HLD_ID.NEXTVAL, TO_DATE(#{startDt}, 'YYYYMMDD'), #{title}, 'Y', 'KR')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NATIONAL_HOLIDAYS WHERE TO_CHAR(HLD_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') = #{hldDate}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO EVENTS ( EVENT_ID, TITLE, START_DT, END_DT, PROJ_ID, WS_ID, USER_ID, ITEM_TYPE, EVENT_COLOR, IS_RECURRING, RECUR_TYPE, RECUR_INTERVAL, RECUR_END_DT, RECUR_GROUP_ID, IS_LUNAR, LUNAR_MONTH, LUNAR_DAY ) VALUES ( SEQ_EVENT_ID.NEXTVAL, #{title}, TO_DATE(#{startDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI'), TO_DATE(#{endDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI') + 1, #{projId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{wsId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{itemType}, #{color, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isRecurring, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{recurType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{recurInterval, jdbcType=NUMERIC},
TO_DATE(#{untilDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') NULL , #{recurGroupId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isLunar, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{lunarMonth, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{lunarDay, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
mapper.select: SELECT e.*, u.USER_NAME FROM EVENTS e JOIN USERS u ON e.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE e.PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND (e.IS_PRIVATE = 'N' OR e.USER_ID = #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PROJ_MEMBERS WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE EVENTS SET START_DT = TO_DATE(#{startDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI'), END_DT = TO_DATE(#{endDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI') + 1 WHERE EVENT_ID = #{id}

UPDATE EVENTS SET TITLE = #{title}, START_DT = TO_DATE(#{startDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI'), END_DT = TO_DATE(#{endDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI') + 1, EVENT_COLOR = #{color}, IS_LUNAR = #{isLunar, jdbcType=CHAR}, LUNAR_MONTH = #{lunarMonth, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, LUNAR_DAY = #{lunarDay, jdbcType=NUMERIC} WHERE EVENT_ID = #{id}

UPDATE EVENTS SET TITLE = #{title}, START_DT = TO_DATE(#{startDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI'), END_DT = TO_DATE(#{endDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI') + 1, EVENT_COLOR = #{color}, RECUR_TYPE = #{recurType}, RECUR_INTERVAL = #{recurInterval}, RECUR_END_DT = TO_DATE(#{untilDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), IS_LUNAR = #{isLunar, jdbcType=CHAR}, LUNAR_MONTH = #{lunarMonth, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, LUNAR_DAY = #{lunarDay, jdbcType=NUMERIC} WHERE RECUR_GROUP_ID = #{recurGroupId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT w.WS_ID as "wsId", w.WS_NAME as "wsName", wm.WS_ROLE as "wsRole" FROM WORKSPACES w JOIN WS_MEMBERS wm ON w.WS_ID = wm.WS_ID WHERE wm.USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT p.PROJ_ID as "projId", p.PROJ_NAME as "projName" FROM PROJECTS p JOIN PROJ_MEMBERS pm ON p.PROJ_ID = pm.PROJ_ID WHERE pm.USER_ID = #{userId}
